resources.string: Connect once with the six-digit code the computer shows. After that, this device finds the computer by itself.
Ready to send pages over Wi-Fi.
On the computer, open God\'s Camera and, under Scanner, turn on receiving scans. The computer and this device must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
This device was removed on the computer. Connect again with a new code.
Connected to the computer through the debugging connection.
The computer answered, but did not accept the token.
The computer cannot be reached through the debugging connection.
Photograph pages with the camera. Edges are found and straightened for you.
Use photos or screenshots you already have.
The document scanner is not available on this device.
Scan a document or choose photos. A long page can be taken in several photos that overlap; the computer joins them into one text.
Connect to a computer to send the pages.
The computer is reading the text… %d %%
Pictures: %1$d · Lines read: %2$d · Repeated lines removed: %3$d
The computer found no text in these pages.
The computer could not be reached
Check that God\'s Camera is open on the computer and that both are on the same Wi-Fi network. Your pages are still here.
The computer did not accept this device
This device was removed on the computer. Connect again with a new code. Your pages are still here.
The computer could not read these pages
Try again, or take the photos once more with more light. Your pages are still here.
On the computer, open God\'s Camera and go to Scanner.
Click “Connect a phone or tablet”. The computer shows a six-digit code.
Choose the computer below and enter the code.
Looking for computers… The computer and this device must be on the same Wi-Fi network, with God\'s Camera open on the computer.
For example 192.168.1.20. On a Windows PC, God\'s Camera shows it under the code. On a Mac, it is under System Settings, Wi-Fi, Details.
That does not look like an address.
No computer with God\'s Camera answered at that address.
The code is on the computer\'s screen and works for a few minutes.
That code did not work. Check the six digits on the computer and enter them again.
The computer is not showing a code right now. On the computer, click “Connect a phone or tablet” to get a new one.
The computer could not be reached. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi network.
The computer has as many devices connected as it takes. Remove one on the computer first.
From now on this device finds the computer by itself whenever both are on the same Wi-Fi network.
No picture: the camera is off on the computer.
Someone in a call sees this
No faces on the computer yet. Add one there, in God\'s Camera\'s Face tab.
Connect to your computer to work its camera from here: the face swap, the loop, and the picture others see.
God\'s Camera on this computer cannot be worked from here yet. Update it to the newest version.
The computer\'s camera cannot be reached right now. Check that God\'s Camera is open there.
Turn the face swap on once at the computer first: it asks you there to accept the rules for swapping a face.
Add a face on the computer first.
That face is no longer on the computer.
A loop can be recorded only while the picture is live.
There is no loop yet. Record one first.
The computer is getting the face swap ready.
A model file is missing on the computer.
The face swap stopped on the computer. Look there for the reason.
No face is in the picture.
The swap is not on the face, so the picture is blurred.
This device will no longer send pages to it. To use it again, connect with a new code.
